en: The Hammadid dynasty, also known as the Hammadid Emirate, as a Berber dynasty in the central Maghreb
Its rule from the Qala of Beni Hammad and later Bejaia
zh: 哈马德王朝又称哈马德埃米尔国，是马格里布中部的柏柏尔王朝
先后以贝尼哈马德堡与贝贾亚为都

politics.zh: 哈马德王朝又称哈马德埃米尔国，是马格里布中部的柏柏尔王朝，11世纪初自齐里王朝分出，先后以贝尼哈马德堡与贝贾亚为都，领有今阿尔及利亚北部。它控制地中海沿岸港口与内陆商路，与齐里王朝、阿尔摩拉维德王朝及西西里的诺曼人长期冲突；1152年被阿尔摩哈德王朝吞并，其地并入更大的马格里布帝国。
politics.en: The Hammadid dynasty, also known as the Hammadid Emirate, was a Berber dynasty in the central Maghreb that separated from the Zirids in the early eleventh century and ruled from the Qala of Beni Hammad and later from Bejaia, over what is now northern Algeria. It controlled the Mediterranean ports and the inland routes and fought for decades with the Zirids, the Almoravids and the Normans of Sicily; in 1152 it was absorbed by the Almohads and its lands passed into their larger Maghrebi empire.

economy.zh: 经济以沿海港口贸易、农业与手工业为基础，贝贾亚是地中海重要港口，与意大利、埃及和西班牙往来密切，谷物、橄榄油、铁与纺织品是主要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on trade through the coastal ports, farming and crafts, with Bejaia an important Mediterranean harbour in close contact with Italy, Egypt and Spain, and grain, olive oil, iron and textiles among the goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 哈马德王朝留下贝尼哈马德堡的宫殿与清真寺遗址，该地已列入世界遗产，阿拉伯语文学与伊斯兰学术在宫廷得到赞助，柏柏尔传统与安达卢斯文化在此交融。
culture.en: The Hammadids left the palace and mosque remains of the Qala of Beni Hammad, now a World Heritage site, Arabic literature and Islamic scholarship were patronised at their court, and Berber tradition met Andalusian culture there.

events.zh: 关键节点包括11世纪初王朝分出、11世纪中叶迁都贝贾亚、12世纪初与阿尔摩拉维德的战争，以及1152年被阿尔摩哈德王朝吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the separation of the dynasty in the early eleventh century, the move of the capital to Bejaia in the mid-eleventh, the wars with the Almoravids in the early twelfth and its absorption by the Almohads in 1152.

value.zh: 先后以贝尼哈马德堡与贝贾亚为都。
value.en: Its capitals were the Qala of Beni Hammad and later Bejaia.
It was absorbed by the Almohads in 1152.

en: The Taifa of Niebla as an Arab taifa kingdom in the south-west of the Iberian Peninsula
Its existence during three distinct periods from 1023
zh: 涅布拉泰法是伊比利亚半岛西南部的阿拉伯泰法王国
自1023年起先后在三个时期存在

politics.zh: 涅布拉泰法是伊比利亚半岛西南部的阿拉伯泰法王国，位于今韦尔瓦省一带，自1023年起先后在三个时期存在，以涅布拉城为中心。它由本地阿拉伯家族统治，控制瓜达尔基维尔河下游与沿海港口，与塞维利亚、巴达霍斯等泰法互动；13世纪中叶被卡斯蒂利亚征服，其地并入卡斯蒂利亚王国。
politics.en: The Taifa of Niebla was an Arab taifa kingdom in the south-west of the Iberian Peninsula, in what is now the province of Huelva, existing during three distinct periods from 1023 and centred on the town of Niebla. Ruled by local Arab families, it controlled the lower Guadalquivir and the coastal ports and interacted with the taifas of Seville and Badajoz; in the mid-thirteenth century it was conquered by Castile and its lands were incorporated into the Castilian kingdom.

economy.zh: 经济以瓜达尔基维尔河下游的农业、渔业、矿业与港口贸易为基础，涅布拉与韦尔瓦一带的港口连接大西洋与地中海航路，金属矿产与农产品是主要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, fishing, mining and port trade on the lower Guadalquivir, with the harbours of Niebla and the Huelva area linking Atlantic and Mediterranean routes, and metals and farm produce among the goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 涅布拉泰法属安达卢斯文化圈，阿拉伯语诗歌与学术在此流传，城堡与清真寺遗址留下遗存，灌溉系统与农业技术延续至基督教统治时期。
culture.en: The taifa belonged to the cultural world of Al-Andalus, Arabic poetry and scholarship circulating there, its castle and mosque remains surviving, and its irrigation systems and farming techniques continuing under Christian rule. Its port at Huelva later carried trade to the Atlantic.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1023年泰法建立、11至12世纪三个时期的分合、12世纪阿尔摩拉维德与阿尔摩哈德统治，以及13世纪中叶被卡斯蒂利亚征服。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the taifa in 1023, its three separate periods in the eleventh and twelfth centuries, Almoravid and Almohad rule in the twelfth and its conquest by Castile in the mid-thirteenth.

value.en: It was centred on the town of Niebla.

value.zh: 13世纪中叶被卡斯蒂利亚征服。
value.en: It was conquered by Castile in the mid-thirteenth century.

en: The Latin Empire, also called the Latin Empire of Constantinople, as a feudal Crusader state founded after the Fourth Crusade
Its replacement of the Byzantine Empire from 1204 to 1261
zh: 拉丁帝国又称君士坦丁堡拉丁帝国，是第四次十字军后建立的封建十字军国家

politics.zh: 拉丁帝国又称君士坦丁堡拉丁帝国，是第四次十字军后于1204年建立的封建十字军国家，取代拜占庭帝国统治君士坦丁堡与色雷斯、希腊部分地区。它由佛兰德伯爵鲍德温一世及其继承者统治，实行西欧封建制度与拉丁教会体系，与尼西亚、伊庇鲁斯等拜占庭残余政权及保加利亚长期交战；1261年尼西亚帝国收复君士坦丁堡，帝国灭亡。
politics.en: The Latin Empire, also known as the Latin Empire of Constantinople, was a feudal Crusader state founded in 1204 after the Fourth Crusade, replacing the Byzantine Empire in Constantinople and ruling Thrace and parts of Greece. Ruled by Baldwin I of Flanders and his successors and organised on western European feudal and Latin ecclesiastical lines, it fought for decades with the Byzantine successor states of Nicaea and Epirus and with Bulgaria; in 1261 Nicaea retook Constantinople and the empire came to an end.

economy.zh: 经济以君士坦丁堡的过境贸易、意大利商人的殖民地与农业为基础，威尼斯与热那亚商人获得广泛特权，黑海与地中海的商路收入被西方商人分享。
economy.en: The economy rested on transit trade through Constantinople, the colonies of the Italian merchants and farming, with Venetian and Genoese traders holding wide privileges and the revenues of the Black Sea and Mediterranean routes shared among western merchants.

culture.zh: 拉丁帝国时期西欧封建与教会制度移植到拜占庭土地，哥特式建筑与拉丁礼仪出现，希腊与拉丁文化并存且冲突不断，拜占庭艺术与抄本传统在尼西亚等地延续。
culture.en: Under the Latin Empire western feudal and ecclesiastical institutions were transplanted onto Byzantine soil, Gothic buildings and Latin liturgy appeared, Greek and Latin cultures coexisted amid constant tension, and Byzantine art and manuscript traditions continued at Nicaea and elsewhere.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1204年建国、1205年与保加利亚的战争、13世纪与尼西亚帝国的长期冲突，以及1261年君士坦丁堡被尼西亚收复。
events.en: Key moments are its foundation in 1204, the war with Bulgaria in 1205, the long conflict with the empire of Nicaea in the thirteenth century and the recovery of Constantinople by Nicaea in 1261. Its last emperor fled to Italy after the city fell.

value.en: It was founded after the Fourth Crusade in 1204.

value.zh: 1261年尼西亚帝国收复君士坦丁堡。

en: The Grand Duchy of Berg, also known as the Grand Duchy of Berg and Cleves, as a territorial grand duchy in western Germany
Its creation by Napoleon in 1806 from the Duchy of Berg
zh: 贝尔格大公国又称贝尔格和克莱沃大公国，是德国西部的领地主权大公国
1806年由拿破仑以贝尔格公国为基础建立

politics.zh: 贝尔格大公国又称贝尔格和克莱沃大公国，是德国西部的领地主权大公国，1806年由拿破仑以贝尔格公国为基础建立，先后由缪拉与拿破仑的侄子拿破仑·路易统治。它推行拿破仑法典与行政改革，1813年拿破仑战败后解散，其地1815年归普鲁士，成为莱茵省的一部分。
politics.en: The Grand Duchy of Berg, also known as the Grand Duchy of Berg and Cleves, was a territorial grand duchy in western Germany created by Napoleon in 1806 from the Duchy of Berg and ruled in turn by Murat and by Napoleon's nephew Napoleon Louis. It introduced the Napoleonic Code and administrative reforms, was dissolved after Napoleon's defeat in 1813, and its lands passed to Prussia in 1815 as part of the Rhine province.

economy.zh: 经济以莱茵河与鲁尔河一带的农业、纺织业与早期煤铁工业为基础，杜塞尔多夫是行政与商业中心，莱茵河航运便利商品流通，法典改革推动了工商业。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, textiles and early coal and iron working in the Rhine and Ruhr area, with Dusseldorf as the administrative and commercial centre, Rhine shipping easing the movement of goods, and legal reform encouraging industry and trade.

culture.zh: 大公国时期杜塞尔多夫成为艺术与行政中心，绘画学院与宫廷文化得到赞助，莱茵地区的民俗与天主教会传统延续，建筑与园林留下遗产。
culture.en: In the period of the grand duchy Dusseldorf became a centre of art and administration, its painting academy and court culture were patronised, the folklore and Catholic traditions of the Rhineland continued, and its buildings and gardens survive as heritage.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1806年大公国建立、1806至1813年的法典与行政改革、1813年拿破仑战败后解散，以及1815年归普鲁士。
events.en: Key moments are the creation of the grand duchy in 1806, the legal and administrative reforms of 1806 to 1813, its dissolution after Napoleon's defeat in 1813 and its passage to Prussia in 1815. Its legal reforms survived long after the duchy itself.

value.en: It was created by Napoleon in 1806.
It was dissolved in 1813 and passed to Prussia in 1815.

en: The County of Osona, also Ausona, as one of the Catalan counties in the north-east of the Iberian Peninsula
Its centre at Vic and its place among the counties that formed Catalonia
zh: 奥索纳伯国又称奥索纳，是伊比利亚半岛东北部加泰罗尼亚诸伯国之一
以维克为中心，是形成加泰罗尼亚的诸伯国之一

politics.zh: 奥索纳伯国又称奥索纳，是伊比利亚半岛东北部加泰罗尼亚诸伯国之一，以维克为中心，9世纪在加洛林边区形成。它由本地伯爵家族统治，与巴塞罗那、赫罗纳及乌赫尔等伯国互动，10世纪后逐步并入巴塞罗那伯国的势力范围；12世纪起随巴塞罗那与阿拉贡的联合而成为阿拉贡王权的一部分。
politics.en: The County of Osona, also known as Ausona, was one of the Catalan counties in the north-east of the Iberian Peninsula, centred on Vic and formed in the ninth century within the Carolingian march. Ruled by local comital families and interacting with the counties of Barcelona, Girona and Urgell, it came increasingly within the orbit of Barcelona after the tenth century; from the twelfth century, with the union of Barcelona and Aragon, it formed part of the Crown of Aragon.

economy.zh: 经济以加泰罗尼亚内陆的农业、畜牧与市镇贸易为基础，维克是主教驻地和market城镇，纺织与皮革手工业在中世纪后期发展，山地牧场支撑畜牧。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding and the trade of its towns in inland Catalonia, with Vic a bishop's seat and market town, textiles and leather crafts developing in the later Middle Ages, and mountain pastures supporting livestock.

culture.zh: 奥索纳伯国留下加泰罗尼亚罗马式建筑的重要遗产，维克主教座堂与修道院是宗教与文化中心，加泰罗尼亚语文献与地方习惯法在此形成，主教与伯爵共同治理。
culture.en: The county left an important heritage of Catalan Romanesque architecture, the cathedral and monasteries of Vic being centres of religion and culture, Catalan documents and local customary law taking shape there, and bishop and count governing together.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪在加洛林边区形成、10世纪与巴塞罗那伯国的关系、11至12世纪的合并进程，以及此后成为阿拉贡王权的一部分。
events.en: Key moments are its formation in the Carolingian march in the ninth century, its relations with the county of Barcelona in the tenth, the process of union in the eleventh and twelfth centuries and its later place within the Crown of Aragon.

value.zh: 后并入巴塞罗那伯国与阿拉贡王权。
value.en: It later passed into the county of Barcelona and the Crown of Aragon.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该伯国的独立条目（该实体没有中文 sitelink），叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this county, the entity having no zhwiki sitelink, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: The Duchy of Oldenburg as a state in the north-west of Germany named after its capital, the town of Oldenburg
Its rule by the House of Oldenburg and its later place among the German states
zh: 奥尔登堡公国是德国西北部的邦国，得名于首府奥尔登堡城
由奥尔登堡家族统治，后成为德意志诸邦之一

politics.zh: 奥尔登堡公国是德国西北部的邦国，得名于首府奥尔登堡城，中世纪为伯国，1774年升格为公国，1815年后为德意志邦联成员。它由奥尔登堡家族统治，该家族还曾取得丹麦与俄罗斯的王位；1866年后与普鲁士结盟，1871年加入德意志帝国，1918年革命后成为奥尔登堡自由邦。
politics.en: The Duchy of Oldenburg was a state in the north-west of Germany named after its capital, the town of Oldenburg, a county in the Middle Ages that was raised to a duchy in 1774 and joined the German Confederation after 1815. Ruled by the House of Oldenburg, which also gained the thrones of Denmark and Russia, it allied with Prussia after 1866 and joined the German Empire in 1871, becoming the Free State of Oldenburg after the revolution of 1918.

economy.zh: 经济以北海沿岸的农业、畜牧、航运与港口贸易为基础，奥尔登堡与后来的威廉港是航运中心，牛马养殖与乳制品是重要产业，沼泽地的开垦扩大了耕地。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding, shipping and port trade along the North Sea coast, with Oldenburg and later Wilhelmshaven as centres of shipping, cattle and horse breeding and dairy produce important industries, and the reclamation of marshland extending arable land.

culture.zh: 奥尔登堡保存北德低地文化，半木结构农舍与教堂是乡村景观，低地德语与地方习俗延续，宫廷与教会赞助教育与音乐，航海传统影响沿海社会。
culture.en: Oldenburg preserved the culture of the north German lowlands, its half-timbered farmhouses and churches shaping the rural landscape, Low German speech and local customs continuing, court and church patronising education and music, and seafaring tradition influencing coastal society.

events.zh: 关键节点包括中世纪伯国的形成、1774年升格为公国、1871年加入德意志帝国，以及1918年革命后成为奥尔登堡自由邦。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the Middle Ages, its elevation to a duchy in 1774, its accession to the German Empire in 1871 and its transformation into the Free State of Oldenburg after the revolution of 1918.

value.en: It was raised to a duchy in 1774.
It joined the German Empire in 1871.

en: Cameroon, officially the Republic of Cameroon, as a country in Central Africa
Its borders with Nigeria to the west and north-west, Chad to the north-east, the Central African Republic to the east and Congo, Gabon and Equatorial Guinea to the south
zh: 喀麦隆正式称喀麦隆共和国，是中非国家
西与西北邻尼日利亚，东北接乍得，东连中非共和国，南接刚果、加蓬与赤道几内亚

politics.zh: 喀麦隆共和国是中非国家，西与西北邻尼日利亚，东北接乍得，东连中非共和国，南接刚果、加蓬与赤道几内亚，首都为雅温得。它在一战前为德国殖民地，战后由法国与英国分别托管，1960年法属部分独立，1961年英属南部地区加入组成联邦，1972年改为单一制共和国，此后长期由同一政党执政。
politics.en: The Republic of Cameroon is a country in Central Africa, bordered by Nigeria to the west and north-west, Chad to the north-east, the Central African Republic to the east and Congo, Gabon and Equatorial Guinea to the south, with Yaounde as its capital. A German colony before the First World War, it was afterwards administered by France and Britain under mandate, the French part becoming independent in 1960 and the southern British part joining it in a federation in 1961, which became a unitary republic in 1972 and has long been governed by a single party.

economy.zh: 经济以石油、可可、咖啡、木材出口与农业为基础，港口杜阿拉是经济中心，石油与木材是重要收入来源，多数人口从事农业，基础设施地区差异明显。
economy.en: The economy rests on oil, cocoa, coffee and timber exports and on farming, with the port of Douala as the economic centre, oil and timber important sources of revenue, most of the population engaged in agriculture and infrastructure uneven between regions.

culture.zh: 喀麦隆有二百多个族群，法语与英语同为官方语言，芳族、巴米累克与富拉尼等文化传统并存，足球与音乐具有全国影响，南北与东西部文化差异明显。
culture.en: Cameroon has more than two hundred communities, with French and English both official, and the cultures of the Fang, Bamileke and Fulani coexisting; football and music have national reach, and cultural differences between north and south and between east and west are marked.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1884年成为德国殖民地、1919年后由法英托管、1960年法属部分独立，以及1961年与英属南部组成联邦并于1972年改为单一制。
events.en: Key moments are its establishment as a German colony in 1884, the French and British mandates after 1919, the independence of the French part in 1960 and the federation with the southern British part in 1961, which became unitary in 1972.

value.zh: 1960年法属部分独立，1961年与英属南部组成联邦。
value.en: The French part became independent in 1960 and federated with the southern British part in 1961.

en: The Sultanate of Ifat, known in Arabic texts as Wafat or Awfat and also called the Kingdom of Zeila, as a medieval Sunni Muslim state in the Horn of Africa
Its position on the trade routes between the Ethiopian highlands and the Red Sea
zh: 伊法特苏丹国在阿拉伯文献中称瓦法特或奥法特，又称泽拉王国，是非洲之角的中世纪逊尼派穆斯林国家
位于埃塞俄比亚高原与红海之间的商路上

politics.zh: 伊法特苏丹国在阿拉伯文献中称瓦法特或奥法特，又称泽拉王国，是非洲之角的中世纪逊尼派穆斯林国家，13至15世纪存在于今埃塞俄比亚东部与吉布提、索马里北部一带，以泽拉港为重要出海口。它由瓦拉什马王朝统治，控制高原与红海之间的商路，与埃塞俄比亚的所罗门王朝长期交战；1415年前后被埃塞俄比亚击败，其地由阿达尔苏丹国继承。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Ifat, known in Arabic texts as Wafat or Awfat and also called the Kingdom of Zeila, was a medieval Sunni Muslim state in the Horn of Africa that existed in the thirteenth to fifteenth centuries in what is now eastern Ethiopia and parts of Djibouti and northern Somalia, with the port of Zeila as its outlet to the sea. Ruled by the Walashma dynasty, it controlled the routes between the highlands and the Red Sea and fought for generations with the Solomonic dynasty of Ethiopia; after defeat around 1415 its lands were taken over by the Sultanate of Adal.

economy.zh: 经济以高原与红海之间的商队贸易、港口贸易与畜牧为基础，泽拉港输出咖啡、黄金、象牙、奴隶与皮革，输入布匹、盐与金属制品，关税与商队税收是主要财源。
economy.en: The economy rested on caravan trade between the highlands and the Red Sea, port trade and herding, with Zeila exporting coffee, gold, ivory, slaves and hides and importing cloth, salt and metal goods, and customs and caravan dues the main sources of revenue.

culture.zh: 伊法特苏丹国是伊斯兰文化与学术在非洲之角的中心之一，清真寺与经学院分布城镇，阿拉伯语用于宗教与文书，索马里语与阿姆哈拉语文化在此交汇，墓葬与碑铭留下遗存。
culture.en: The sultanate was one of the centres of Islamic culture and learning in the Horn of Africa, its towns having mosques and colleges, Arabic serving religion and documents, Somali and Amharic cultures meeting there, and tombs and inscriptions surviving as remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括13世纪苏丹国建立、与埃塞俄比亚所罗门王朝的长期战争、1415年前后的战败，以及此后由阿达尔苏丹国继承其地位。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the sultanate in the thirteenth century, the long wars with the Solomonic dynasty of Ethiopia, the defeat around 1415 and the succession of the Sultanate of Adal to its position.

value.zh: 以泽拉港为重要出海口。
value.en: The port of Zeila was its outlet to the sea.

value.zh: 此后由阿达尔苏丹国继承。
value.en: It was succeeded by the Sultanate of Adal.
